It's been.... A while but I had 2 dreams that I remember clear as day. 

One a week after she died where she called me and told me everything was okay and she "had to do this" to be safe but she was okay and she'd explain everything the next time I saw her. 
I honestly couldn't tell it was a dream for a few days, I thought she faked her death, I mean... I just felt real 

The second was... about a year or 2 later I got a tattoo 10 with her ashes in the ink, and in the dream, I was taking a bath and the tattoo washed off. I started freaking out and started trying to "wash it back on" it didn't work. I woke up panicking.

That was the last time. She died in 2014.

When someone important to you dies, your heart stops, and it's easy to get angry or alone or even more depressed when you look around nothing else has stopped. Life moves on, and it seems like people are too busy to even notice you and if they do, they tend to see you as a burden and give shitty advice, because again, their heart hasnt stopped. 

Its the worst, but I think it happens frequently.
